artboards.title: A2 — The slab stamps the numbers

annotations.text:
Song detail

Two columns on desktop: chart left at a 40ch measure, takes right with room to be a real list. On a phone the same two blocks stack, takes first — you open a song to hear it, not to read it.

No left indent anywhere; the chorus label is muted like every other section and the emphasis sits on the words.

Take row — V2 chosen, strictly

Yes, it is one component: six call sites, three context modes, and not one opts out of the vote control or hides it once a take is a keeper. That is most of what looked wrong.

Decided: keeper / not-a-keeper lives ONLY on take detail — not in any list, including home's "needs your vote", which becomes a queue of things to go and listen to rather than a place to judge them unheard.

The left column is what changes regardless.

Instruments — second attempt

The first icon set was twelve SVG paths I wrote by hand from imagination. Withdrawn.

These are Game Icons, drawn as one family — the only set surveyed that covers a band. Lucide, Tabler, Phosphor and Material between them have guitar, piano, microphone and violin, and no drums, trombone, flute or clarinet.

The catch is CC BY 3.0: visible attribution, which every self-deployer inherits. Read the two notes at the bottom before deciding.

Milestone 2 — primitive skins

Label (S3) was chosen, then revised twice: outlines replaced by fills, then the fills roughly doubled in weight.

The revised board is above; the three original candidates are below it for reference.

The three notes along the bottom of the revised board are the interesting part — raising the fills broke two things that had to be fixed rather than ignored.

Type revisit

TOP — eight contemporary slabs including Zilla Slab, your current pick. Same sizes, same Czech titles, the column layout from the meta-line decision. Available weights and a measured title width on each.

BELOW LEFT — the original four (now rendering correctly; the first version had a quoting bug that fell every column back to Georgia).

BELOW RIGHT — meta lines. Settled: columns in lists, labelled fields on detail pages, a 1px rule where a line must stay inline. Never the middot.

Milestone 3 — the shell

Three structurally different answers to one question: where does navigation live, and how does the player relate to it. Everything after this inherits the answer, which is why it comes before the primitives.

Each board shows the SAME screen — an event with takes, one playing — at phone and desktop width, so the difference you see is the shell and nothing else. Tokens, type and rows are identical across all three.

Logo — 05 Cut chosen (2026-09-08)

Twelve candidates. 01-06 work the plate itself; 07-12 push outside it — dub delay, the sound system, the offbeat chop, the letterform.

05 Cut won on meaning: a dubplate is cut, once, for one sound, and it is the only mark here that shows the verb the app is named after. It also holds at 16px.

Shipped in apps/web/public/ with a simplified sub-32px variant; spec in docs/design-foundation.md.

Milestone 1 — settled

Direction A's palette, A3's typography rule. Written up in docs/design-foundation.md. This is the sheet milestone 2 builds primitives against.

Milestone 1b — A without the mono

A3 was chosen: mono kept, but only where a character grid carries meaning.
Milestone 1 — the two directions not taken. Kept for reference.
